exclusions.source_text: Participants with known brain metastases are excluded from this clinical trial
Participant is not pregnant or breastfeeding, and at least one of the following conditions applies:
HIV-infected participants must have well-controlled HIV on ART, defined as:
New York Heart Association Class III or IV congestive heart failure, unstable angina, myocardial infarction, uncontrolled symptomatic arrhythmia, prolongation of QTcF interval to >480 ms
Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 3 years.
Has CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
Is receiving chronic systemic steroid therapy
